links.outcome: Radiologist-reported AI impact on workflow efficiency, burnout, and turnaround time
links.effect: Respondents reported great impacts on workflow efficiency (109, 73.2%), reducing burnout (70, 47.0%), and turnaround time (70, 47.0%); integration was a barrier (98, 62.0%).
links.quote: Additionally, respondents reported AI tools have great impacts on workflow efficiency (109, 73.2%), patient care (98, 65.8%), reducing burnout (70, 47.0%), turnaround time (70, 47.0%), and addressing radiologist shortages (69, 46.3%).

screen.reason: Survey of breast radiologists evaluating adoption, perceptions, benefits, and barriers of AI-based CAD tools in clinical practice.
